node.title: Clara — Context Engineering for AI agents
node.summary: Bootstraps AI coding agents with institutional knowledge from past PRs and tickets, delivers agentic PRs with a human in the loop, and learns from every merge.
node.interview_question: If Cursor and Copilot keep adding their own codebase context, what's left for Clara to own?

competitor.name: Cursor
competitor.positioning: Cursor/Copilot add in-IDE codebase context natively and own the session; they argue context belongs in the tool, not a separate platform.
